extensions.name: bugs-music
extensions.description: Bugs Music metadata provider with accurate track and album details, artist catalogs, TOP100, all genre charts from Bugs genre home, Music PD albums, and URL imports. Multi-source ISRC matching across Deezer, Spotify, MusicBrainz, iTunes and YouTube Music with hangul romanization fallback, 260+ artist aliases, iTunes hangul-latin bridging with English-registration feedback re-search, artist-name variant search, romaja-title queries and romaja fallback naming for romanized download sources, album-level lookup, variant-ISRC retry, and duration-verified scoring, Bugs CONNECT-badge cleanup, and variant-title demotion (instrumental/karaoke candidates lose to canonical ones). Hands confirmed Deezer/Spotify track identifiers (deezer_id/spotify_id) to the app's download resolver so downloads resolve directly instead of falling back to name search. Rate-limit pacing, transient-failure retry, and a 90s background requeue of blocked lookups keep 100-track batch matching from starving. An off-by-default switch (DELIVER_APPLE_MUSIC_ID) stands ready to hand the Apple Music track identifier (apple_music_id) to the app's download resolver once the app confirms support for appleMusic identifiers; until then the delivered payload is identical to 2.2.2.
